confidence_notes: FX is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 observation (0.6720, found via search of RBA pages). Food and drink anchors are based on one web search of aggregated cost-of-living sources (Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere and similar). Those showed a draft beer of about €3.4–3.8, a cappuccino of about €3.7–4.2, an inexpensive meal of about €10.3 and a mid-range meal for two of about €51.5. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices were not found. I estimated them from the local price relationship to beer: cocktail at roughly 2x beer, and a glass of wine at roughly 1.1x beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings, and are the least certain. Gdansk has strong summer seasonality, and the pricing window is July 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Warsaw and Krakow: Gdansk is slightly cheaper than Warsaw for food, with higher summer accommodation prices because of Baltic coast tourism.
